text.tspan: The church’s high ceiling and extensive hard surfaces created strong reflections and
reverberation, letting sound linger far longer than desired and blurring speech, music
and amplified sound. We designed and installed an acoustic ceiling using Rockfon
Arctic tiles as the key element of the sound-management strategy, adding
absorption across the large overhead surface while preserving the room’s bright,
open character. The congregation now experiences speech and music with greater
Acoustic assessment of the worship space
Ceiling design integrated with existing architecture
Clean, uniform finish that performs and decorates
